serverInfo.name: SupplyGraph AI MCP Server
serverInfo.title: SupplyGraph.AI (Daasmart)
serverInfo.description: SupplyGraph.AI MCP server for the Daasmart market. Supply-chain tools include company search, tariff calculation, enterprise-change monitoring, and risk prediction. It also exposes China geo and registry data agents as tools: (1) POI — named, map-located facilities in an administrative area (schools, hospitals, gas stations, banks/ATMs, pharmacies, restaurants, brand outlets), not counts; (2) park — enterprises and attributes of a named industrial park or development zone; (3) region — province/city/district aggregate indicators (population, GDP, fiscal, investment, employment, land, housing, traffic, public services), totals and trends only, no name lists; (4) industry — enterprise lists or counts under a named industry chain (e.g. NEV, low-altitude economy, ICs), optionally scoped by region; (5) company — look up one known firm by name or USCC, or filter firms by region and business-registration conditions without requiring a chain or park name (registered capital, industry, status, abnormal operations, dishonesty, listing, social-insurance headcount, founding year, keywords); (6) address nearby — population, housing prices, facilities, and similar indicators around a specific address, landmark, road, community, or park gate, not around an admin region alone. Get an API key from Console → Developer Settings → A2A/MCP Keys and send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
